text:
raj: FYI noticed regression in paged-KV after allocator refactor landed in canary. Seen increased 95p latency and a couple OOMs on extended chat runs.
molly: ugh. which refactor? removing freelist? bump only?
raj: removed size-class freelists, moved to per-thread bump-pointer to reduce locks. landed 2026-02-15 to canary gpu-a. infra-bot deployed at 10:12Z.
infra-bot: Deployed allocator-refactor:v1 to canary (gpu-a) at 2026-02-15T10:12:03Z.
kevin: repro script? we need numbers not vibes.
raj: repro: seq=4096, 12k KV pages per worker, concurrency 16. Observed: ~30% fragmented free space, avg free-run ~2.8 pages, failed contiguous alloc attempts spike.
molly: any perf breakdown? memcpy vs kernel time?
raj: small flame sample: memcpy_pc_ie ~34% (was 14%), kernel_exec down ~48% -> 56% relative mix shift, alloc_lookup cpu time up x3.
jia: that memcpy jump smells like non-contiguous pages forcing extra PCIe transfers per KV access.
kevin: could the kernel-selection logic be picking different attention kernels based on page layout?
raj: possible. We saw more fallbacks to fallback_attn when contiguous KV couldn't be used. Telemetry shows kernel_variant:fallback rose from 0.3% -> 3.6% on canary.
molly: options brainstorm: (1) reintroduce size buckets + freelist, (2) implement fast coalescing on free, (3) background compaction, (4) change eviction to prefer freeing contiguous runs.
jia: (1) is low-risk and cheap to implement. (3) is expensive but better for long-lived fragmentation.
raj: constraints: cannot stop-the-world for >50ms during inference. any compaction must be background and incremental.
kevin: agree start small. Bring back size buckets for common page counts (1,2,4,8,16) + coalesce adjacent extents on free if same owner thread. Use bump fallback when no bucket fit.
molly: also add metrics: kv_frag_pct, avg_free_run, contiguous_alloc_fails, kernel_variant_counts. We can alert on contiguous_alloc_fails>5/min.
raj: prototype allocator change: keep per-thread bump for speed, but maintain global bucketed freelists with a lightweight compare-and-swap push/pop. On free, attempt to merge with previous free extent via atomic range coalesce.
jia: micro-optimization: maintain small-range index (radix or interval tree) to find large extents quickly instead of scanning buckets for >32-page requests.
kevin: implement buckets+coalesce first. If failures persist after two runs, add compaction or index.
molly: perf plan: add end-to-end harness that runs seq=4096 long-chat with user-simulated prefixes, measure tokens/sec and 95p latency both for fused-attn and paged-attn variants. Baseline vs patch.
raj: adding benchmark job now: job id paged-kv-frag-repro-1769. benchbot queued it on canary pool.
benchbot: queued paged-kv-frag-repro-1769 on gpu-a (ETA 18m).
raj: tests to include: unit allocator correctness, fragmentation unit test that randomly alloc/frees sizes and assert contiguous_alloc_fails stays low, perf integration measuring memcpy ratio.
molly: add a sparse kernel pointer indirection: kernels keep a soft pointer to KV region; compaction can update indirections atomically to avoid kernel restart. Adds indirection cost but enables background compaction later.
jia: indirection adds load to hot path. only do if needed. prefer to see metrics first.
kevin: rollout criteria: 95p latency increase <= +5% and no OOMs at scale; kernel-fallback rate <= baseline+1%. If bucketed fix meets criteria, we ship to production.
raj: I'll open PR today with: buckets+coalesce, added metrics, unit tests, perf harness changes, bench job config. tagging @molly @jia for review.
molly: lgtm, assign me for perf verification once canary runs complete.
raj: noted. planning follow-up on Thursday after canary runs.
kevin: thanks for quick triage. keep infra-bot posted when canary perf lands. :thumbsup:
